description: Provision (purchase) a Canadian phone number to your account. The phone_number comes from search_phone_numbers results. Live keys only: a test key gets 403 LIVE_KEY_REQUIRED. This spends real money: the first month's rent plus a one-time activation fee are debited together the moment the number is bought (search results and get_pricing show both amounts), and rent recurs monthly until release_phone_number. A balance that cannot cover the total returns 402 INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE with nothing charged. Accounts are capped on how many numbers they may hold at once: a per-account limit that falls back to a platform-wide default staff can change at runtime. Exceeding it returns NUMBER_LIMIT_REACHED, and a higher allowance is requested with request_number_allowance. May also return a 409 PURCHASE_IN_PROGRESS if another purchase for this account is already running; this is transient and safe to retry after a short delay, unlike the terminal 409 returned when the number is already owned, it does not mean the purchase failed. Parallel purchases on one account produce it.

phone_number.description: E.164 phone number to provision (e.g. +14165551234). Must be from the search_phone_numbers results.
